talks.title: Quantized inference without the hype
talks.speaker: Ximena Mensah
talks.abstract: We share the mistakes we made with quantized inference and how we fixed them. No prior experience is needed, but familiarity with the basics helps. Organizers of past editions told us to plan for around 67 people.
